comments.body: I got this quest with just over 30k Adventure fame. I think it helps if you do the quest "Treasure of the kings of Troy" that gets you the Archaeologist Job card before trying to get this quest. Also, this quest showed for me while I was trying to get the quest "Chain of curiosity" to show which I've so far used 70+ QMP on. It also probably helps to have spanish, french and greek like I did.
